answer: Latency-Shaped Attestation Trails. Each identity must emit reply-timing traces whose inter-arrival gaps match a seeded baseline over a fixed horizon. Enforced by hashing timestamp deltas into a rolling onyx ledger; mismatched shapes are throttled to zero bandwidth. An attacker faking N identities pays the wall-clock cost of replaying each distinct baseline, since shared timing fingerprints collapse into one cluster. Mimicking independent shapes requires real per-identity compute, raising the marginal cost of a haven of clones far above the value of a single sybil submission.
